one_line: Number each reason on screen, change the setting with each, and hold the product while you say it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a mother on a living-room floor lifts a smiling baby, a pink pump on a stone table beside her. Voiceover to camera (transcript, garbled): why she chose Annabella. Text, lower third: 'למה בחרתי באנבלה'.
q1_hook.why: A person, a voice, text and the product in frame at once pass the skip test (H1, H4, H6). The question 'why I chose it' opens a gap that the five reasons close (H5). The text sits in the lower third with a sparkle effect, which makes the hook the hardest line to read (T4).

beats.what: Floor, baby lifted, pump on the table; 'למה בחרתי באנבלה'
beats.why: A question with a smiling mother and the product in view.

beats.what: Sofa, she holds the pump parts; '1 שאיבה דו-צדדית', 'את יכולה לחבר אותה כאן בקליפס'
beats.why: First numbered reason, product close to the lens.

beats.what: Kitchen, she walks wearing the pump in a pink bra; '2 מגיעה עם חזיית הנקה', 'בלי ידיים'
beats.why: The hands-free claim is shown by movement.

beats.what: Floor, baby on her lap; '3 שימוש נעים נוח וללא כאב', 'המשאבה לא כואבת'
beats.why: New room and a baby keep the picture fresh.

beats.what: Sofa, a pump part held up; '4 תנועה טבעית של הלשון', 'בצורה של גלים'
beats.why: The product is the subject again.

beats.what: Closer on the sofa; '5 הגברה של ייצור החלב', 'אוקסיטוצין'
beats.why: Longest explanation, spoken claim with nothing new shown.

beats.what: Wide sofa shot, a box beside her; 'אז אם את בהריון ומחפשת את ה-משאבה'
beats.why: Names the buyer, a pregnant mother, before the close.

beats.what: Kitchen, baby on her hip, pump worn; 'בתור אמא שמניקה ושואבת', 'כבר 10 חודשים', 'רק אנבלה'
beats.why: Her own long use and the product on her body close it.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None to comment, share or tag. The caption asks for a purchase decision ('תוסיפי את משאבת אנבלה בלי לחשוב פעמיים'), not an interaction.
q2_flow.why: Five numbered reasons, each with a big number and a new setting, give a clear list that answers the opening question (H5, R3). Cuts every 3 to 4 s keep it moving (E2). The 0:18 to 0:21 reason is spoken claim over a static face (R3). Nothing prompts a send, though a pregnant friend is the obvious recipient (R5).

q3_cta.what: No ask in the video: the spoken close is a recommendation, 'אז אם את בהריון ומחפשת את ה-משאבה', then 'רק אנבלה' (0:28). Caption: 'תוסיפי את משאבת אנבלה בלי לחשוב פעמיים'. No link, code or keyword.
q3_cta.why: One message in voice, text and caption: choose this pump (C1, C6). But it has no mechanism, no link, code or comment word, so a convinced viewer has to search (C3). 'בלי לחשוב פעמיים' is pressure, not information (K6).

q4_shown.what: The pink pump on a stone table at 0:00; held to the lens 0:03 and 0:15 to 0:24; worn in a pink bra while she walks with a baby 0:07 and 0:25 to 0:29. A baby on her lap 0:10. No price, no result.
q4_shown.why: Wearing it while walking shows the hands-free claim instead of describing it (K5, R3). 'כבר 10 חודשים' is first-hand use, the strongest vouch here (S6). The claims about less pain and more milk are only said, and stated as fact (K4).

q5_edit.what: 8 shots in 29 s, about 3.7 s each, straight cuts, one per numbered reason, static framing inside each shot; no speed changes seen. A large number and heading per reason, subtitles in short chunks. Ends on a standing shot with 'רק אנבלה'.
q5_edit.why: One cut per reason and a new room each time make the list easy to follow, at a moderate pace (E2, R3). Number plus subtitle works muted (T1, E4). It ends on the last line with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Five reasons she chose one wearable breast pump, from a mother who has pumped for ten months. Serves a pregnant or new mother choosing a pump.
q6_topic.why: It meets a pending purchase in a named life moment, pregnancy and the first months (K7). Her own months of use make it personal (K6). The caption's 'only pump in the world' and 'more milk in less time' are strong claims with no source in the Reel (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod, static, eye level, in a bright home: floor with a stone table, sofa by a brick wall, kitchen by a fridge. Lapel mic visible. She holds the pump up to the lens or wears it. One adult, one baby.
q7_filmed.why: Direct address and her own home read as personal and clean (F6, H8, F7). Holding a part close to the lens fills the frame so the pink parts read on a phone (F4). The baby and a worn pump are not copyable by LumeBook.

q8_text.on_screen: Hook 'למה בחרתי באנבלה' in white script with a sparkle, at about 70% of frame height (0:00). Each reason: a large cream number and bold heading: '1 שאיבה דו-צדדית' (0:03), '2 מגיעה עם חזיית הנקה' (0:07), '3 שימוש נעים נוח וללא כאב' (0:10), '4 תנועה טבעית של הלשון' (0:14), '5 הגברה של ייצור החלב' (0:18). 1, 4, 5 at top, 2, 3 lower right. Subtitles mid-frame. 'רק אנבלה' (0:28).
q8_text.caption: 'מהרגע שילדתי ועד היום, אני שואבת עם אנבלה 🤍'. Medium length: three emoji bullets of claims, a line to the pregnant reader, the purchase push, 'בשיתוף @annabellabreastpump', five hashtags (#אמא, #הנקה, #הריון...). No question.
q8_text.why: A big number and a short heading per reason read fast and work muted (T1, T2). The hook and numbers 2 and 3 fall in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption names the product and the audience and opens in first person, with generic hashtags (T7). 'בשיתוף' comes after the claims (T8, S7).

weak_points: The hook and two numbers sit in the bottom band; health claims and 'only pump in the world' stated as fact; no price, code or link; a baby and a worn pump cannot be copied.
lumebook_takeaway: Five numbered reasons with a big number at the top, one setting per reason, the book held up to the lens each time. Hands and book, no child.
not_verified: The machine transcript is garbled, so quotes follow the burned-in subtitles. Whether the baby is hers; what the green item at 0:07 is; the paid-partnership label (1 per media info, not visible in frames). The health claims are not checked. Correction: the hook text sits in the lower third, and the first frame shows the pump on a table beside her.
